verdict.rationale: An AI Q&A capability with citations is a fair question for a project-tracking workspace like GitHub Projects, but the evidence pack never documents asking AI questions and getting cited answers from project content. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: assigning issues to Copilot is delegating work, while the GraphQL API query and the official MCP server are developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
